description: Save reviewed edits to an existing brief, including must_cover, must_avoid, source_urls, example_urls, competitor_urls, cta, notes, outline (ordered H2 titles) and facts (supplied claims; a list replaces them, needs the v2 article pipeline). Omitted fields stay unchanged; [] or null clears a supported field. Editing a generation-relevant field on an already-approved brief moves it back to draft so the next generation re-enters review (re-pointing pillar_id alone does not); call approve_brief to restore approval.

body.description:
Partial update for a developer-authored brief.

Every field is optional; only supplied fields are patched. Brand and
status are not editable here. Omitting a key leaves it unchanged. An
explicit ``null`` clears a nullable field. ``secondary_keywords``,
``outline``, ``must_cover``, ``must_avoid``, ``source_urls``,
``example_urls``, ``competitor_urls``, and ``attached_document_ids`` also
accept ``[]`` to empty the set. Editing any field that affects generation
on an already-approved brief moves its status back to ``draft`` so the
next generation re-enters review. Explicit ``null`` is rejected with a
**422** on ``title`` and ``format``.

items.description:
A fact you supply for the article to cite (request).

One line of plain text, at most 200 characters, with no Markdown, HTML,
links or ``[[``/``]]``. ``source_url`` is optional: its page is fetched
at generation and the fact is cited to it only when the page states every
figure and name in the fact; otherwise the fact is used without a link
(a regulated workspace leaves it out). A ``source_url`` the brand source
policy or the workspace's blocked hosts refuse is a 422
(``user_fact_source_url_ineligible``), and workspaces with
regulated-content settings must supply one (422
``user_fact_source_url_required``). Generation applies these rules again
and leaves out a fact that no longer meets them. At most 20 facts, at
most 5 with ``priority=must_use``.
